cases.subject: community rescue
cases.story: The volunteers at a neighborhood library say they reopened a room of water-damaged books by sunrise after a storm. There is an estimate of 800 rescued books, but no date, source, or clearly defined audience. Tell this as a LinkedIn editorial carousel.
expected: ask whether 800 is documented or approximate
ask who the audience or narrator is, or what emotional focus matters
no slide generation or completed storyboard
note uncertainty instead of asserting fully verified rescue

cases.subject: product incident
cases.story: Internal postmortem: on Oct 3, 2026, a feature toggle accidentally blocked checkout for 11 minutes. Logs show 62 attempted checkouts failed; one engineer disabled the toggle after an alert. Audience: engineers. Goal: tell the discovery in a matter-of-fact editorial LinkedIn carousel. These numbers are from our internal logs.
expected: can proceed with 2-3 meaningful narrative angles without unnecessary questions
distinguish internal report from independent verification

cases.subject: scope control
cases.story: Just answer: does this repository contain a harness? Do not generate.
expected: answer the direct question, no story drafting or generation

cases.subject: uncertain marketing result

expected: question baseline and evidence for doubled signups
no fake percentage as established fact
